Population increased in South Norfolk

The estimated population of South Norfolk in 2024 was 148,448 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that South Norfolk's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of South Norfolk increased by 4.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, South Norfolk was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of South Norfolk

The average (median) age fell to 46.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of South Norfolk has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
South Norfolk is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, South Norfolk's population of 148,448 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,924 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.5%)
  • 85,752 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.8%)
  • 36,772 people aged 65 years and over, (24.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, South Norfolk has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (24.8% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In South Norfolk, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Norfolk
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Norfolk, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 353 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 1,177 births and 1,530 deaths in South Norfolk.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,535 (1%). There were 9,609 people entering the area and 8,074 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Norfolk's population of 592 (0.4%) as a result of 911 people entering the area and 319 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for South Norfolk was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of South Norfolk in mid-2023 is 146,645.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 203 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 213 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 10 people.
